text: The satellites checked for fire detections on this asset were VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS. These satellites are part of the NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) dataset, which provides active fire and thermal anomaly detections. The data covers the period from October 4, 2026, to November 3, 2026, and includes near real-time observations.
